text_block_list.text:
Смарт Фалкон is performing well in her
races. As
her popularity increases, so
does the number of
people who come to
see her street performances.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She comes to me with a shocking
request, saying
she wants to take on the
Satsuki Sho for her next
race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Not only is she ill-suited for running on
turf, the
Classic Triple Crown draws in
the very best racers
of each generation.
Winning will be no easy feat.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
All the same, Смарт Фалкон insists on
entering.
She wants her fans to hear her
sing a song that
can only be sung on the
Classic Triple Crown tour.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
